estimates.t: Certain accounting policies require us to make estimates and judgments in determining the amounts reflected in our Consolidated Financial Statements.

estimates.name: Forward-Looking Statements
estimates.t: Forward-looking statements include statements which are predictive in nature, which depend upon or refer to future events or conditions, or which include words such as “expects,” “anticipates,” “intends,” “plans,” “believes,” “estimates” or similar expressions.
